preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The maximum path length l is between 1 and n inclusive.
The maximum path weight w is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi < i + 1 for i, (pi, wi) in enumerate(edges))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertex (i + 1) to a previous vertex pi where 1 <= pi < (i + 1).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi <= 10**4 for pi, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight wi is between 0 and 10,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The number of close pairs is between 0 and the total number of unique vertex pairs (v, u) where v < u.

postconditions.expression: all((v, u) for v in range(1, n) for u in range(v + 1, n + 1) if is_close(v, u, l, w, edges))
postconditions.description: The output counts all pairs (v, u) where v < u and there exists a path of length at most l and weight at most w between them.
